name: async-switch
title: Async switch
description: A switch for settings that save at once: a spinner in the thumb while it waits, a rollback with a retry if the save fails, and the result read out.
docs: onCheckedChange(next) gets the position the switch is moving to. Return a promise and the switch waits for it: it moves at once, shows a spinner in the thumb, ignores further presses and says aria-busy; if the promise rejects, the thumb slides back and the message appears under the label with a Retry button, and if it resolves, Saved shows for successFor milliseconds (default 2000), in the row of the label so the description never narrows or wraps again (in a column narrower than 16rem it is the check alone, so a long label does not wrap either). Pass checked and update it in the handler once the save worked, or use defaultChecked and let the switch keep its own state the same way. A handler that returns nothing just changes the switch. status drives the display yourself, for example status={mutation.status}; Retry then calls onCheckedChange with the position that failed. successMessage, errorMessage and retryLabel change the words, which are read out politely. Under reduced motion the thumb jumps and the spinner is a still ellipsis.
